title: USF Semantic Contract Schema
description: Draft JSON Schema for rank-1 semantic contracts (capability facets and related contracts). Carries an authority level (authority-levels) and lifecycle state (lifecycle-states), governed ontology concepts, and a facet set; a facet asserted complete MUST cite authoritative evidence, otherwise it is a gap. Governs the ontology concepts Semantic Contract, Capability, Port, Interface, Configuration, and Data Model. NOTE: the capability-domains vocabulary value set is DEFERRED (no canonical values authored yet); therefore capabilityDomain is modelled as an open string and is NOT enum-constrained here, recorded as deferred per schema-authoring-standard and the vocabulary catalogue. Validators MUST NOT accept historical capability labels as canonical until that value set is populated. lifecycleState draft; not active.

status.$comment: A facet is 'complete' only with authoritative backing; otherwise 'gap'.

allOf.$comment: Drop to gap if backing is missing: a complete facet must cite at least one evidence or source reference.

capabilityDomain.$comment: DEFERRED value set capability-domains: open string until canonical values are authored; do not treat historical ../react labels as canonical.

facets.$comment: Historical facet set: lifecycle, stateModel, permissions, contracts, validation, errorModel, auditModel, readinessModel, proof, uiSemanticDefinition.
